title: Payout Methods Minimum and Maximum Transfer Amounts
content:
Every Payout Methods rail has a smallest transfer it sends and a largest single transfer it sends, both in USD.

| Rail | Smallest transfer sent | Largest single transfer |
|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH) | USD 1.00 | USD 250000.00 |
| Fast Pay Debit Card | USD 1.00 | USD 25000.00 |
| PayPal | USD 1.00 | USD 60000.00 |
| Payoneer | USD 20.00 | USD 50000.00 |
| International Wire Transfer | USD 100.00 | USD 1000000.00 |
| Western Union Cash Pickup | USD 20.00 | USD 2999.00 |

## What happens outside the limits (every rail)

- **Below the smallest transfer:** the amount is kept in the undisbursed balance until the balance reaches the minimum.
- **Above the largest single transfer:** the amount is split into consecutive transfers of at most the maximum on the same day.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

| Imagined situation | Result under the limits |
|---|---|
| Payoneer method, amount due USD 19.99 | Below USD 20.00: kept in the undisbursed balance until the balance reaches USD 20.00 |
| Payoneer method, amount due USD 20.00 | Equal to the minimum: not below it, so the minimum does not keep it in the balance |
| International Wire Transfer method, amount due USD 99.00 | Below USD 100.00: kept in the balance |
| Western Union Cash Pickup method, amount due USD 7000.00 | Above USD 2999.00: split into consecutive transfers on the same day, none of them above USD 2999.00 |
| Fast Pay Debit Card method, amount due USD 25000.00 | Equal to the maximum: not above it, so it is not split |
